Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity

Class HumanoidBrainEntity

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.Entity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.BrainEntity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.HumanoidBrainEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Listener
Direct Known Subclasses:
YamlBrainHumanoidEntity
public abstract class HumanoidBrainEntity extends BrainEntity
A BrainEntity that additionally applies a custom player skin to the spawned Mannequin, mirroring the role that HumanoidEntity plays in the legacy DumbEntity hierarchy.

Subclass this when you want both the brain system (sensors + goals) and a custom skin on a mannequin entity.

Subclass contract:

  1. Set skinData in your constructor (before spawn(org.bukkit.Location) is called) to provide texture information. If skinData is null at spawn time the mannequin keeps its default appearance and a warning is logged.
  2. Override BrainEntity.configureBrain(com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.MannequinBrain, org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) to register your sensors and goals — same as with plain BrainEntity.

Minimal example: 


 public class ElvenArcherEntity extends HumanoidBrainEntity {

     public ElvenArcherEntity(JavaPlugin plugin) {
         super(plugin, "elven_archer",
               Component.text("Elven Archer", NamedTextColor.GREEN));
         this.skinData = new SkinData(
             "elven_archer",
             UUID.fromString("..."),
             "ewogIjEy...",   // textureValue
             "abc123..."      // textureSignature (optional)
         );
     }

     {@literal @}Override
     protected void configureBrain(MannequinBrain brain, Mannequin mannequin) {
         brain.getTargetSelector()
              .addGoal(1, new NearestPlayerTargetGoal(plugin));
         brain.getNormalSelector()
              .addGoal(1, new LookAtPlayerGoal());
     }
 }

    • skinData

      protected SkinData skinData
      Skin data applied to every mannequin spawned by this entity type. Set this field in your constructor before any call to spawn(org.bukkit.Location). May be null — the entity will still spawn but will use the default mannequin appearance.

  • Method Details

    • spawn

      public org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin spawn(org.bukkit.Location location)
      Spawns the mannequin, applies the skin, then delegates to BrainEntity.spawn(org.bukkit.Location) which builds and starts the brain.

      Skin application happens before brain configuration so that goals which inspect the mannequin's profile immediately after registration see the correct skin.

      Overrides:
      spawn in class BrainEntity
      Parameters:
      location - where to spawn the entity
      Returns:
      the spawned Bukkit entity

    • applySkin

      public void applySkin(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin, SkinData skinData)
      Applies the given SkinData to a mannequin by constructing a PlayerProfile with the appropriate texture property and setting it via Paper's ResolvableProfile API.

      Identical in behaviour to HumanoidEntity.applySkin(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin, com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.SkinData) so that skin definitions are interchangeable between the legacy and brain-based hierarchies.

      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin to skin
      skinData - the skin to apply
